analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($279.67)/SMA200 ($267.99): below long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (0.8998→-2.3767): continued worsening, confirming bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $224.73): approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($255.40): resistance based on SMA50, breakthrough attempts mid-term trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low): confirming continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): maintaining wait-and-see due to daily oversold entry and trendless period.
